thread:
evan: Quick sync: RFC follow-up proposing an ingress-side compact attribution header to cut late-join queries. Goal: attach tenant-id (compact), resolve_version, and a signer tag at proxy. Thoughts on failure modes + rollout?

jia: Good. Two immediate concerns: cross-proxy retries and sampling. If retries hit different proxies with different cache state we can end up with inconsistent headers.

rob: Mitigation: proxies should honor incoming header if present and valid, never overwrite. Also include resolve_epoch so downstream can pick the earliest epoch when multiple headers seen.

zoe: Sampling: sampled traces may drop headers. Proposal: emit a tiny anonymized mapping event to a short-lived topic for sampled requests so we can replay attribution if needed. No PII in mapping.

evan: Performance: prototype shows ~130us median hit, p95 ~380us; header adds ~8 bytes avg. We'll circuit-break remote lookups and treat cache-miss as best-effort (emit fallback metric).

jia: Security: signer rotation must support grace windows. We'll include epoch id and accept previous epoch for 5m. Also allow tenant opt-out for regulated customers.

rob: Rollout: internal dev -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 100%. Dashboards: header_accept_rate, invalid_sig_rate, fallback_rate, delta_attr_rate. Alert on delta_attr_rate >1% for 10m.

obs-bot: flag enabled: ingress_attrib_canary=cohort=1% in us-east-1.

evan: Action items: i'll draft spec with header TLV + signer epochs; jia add retry tests; zoe build canary dashboard. Will post PR link. :rocket:
